easy: Kind and caring, and wanting to stop pain or suffering.

ex.en: The humane farmer took good care of his sick cow.
ex.ko: 그 자비로운 농부는 아픈 소를 정성껏 돌봤다.

easy: Allowed by the law.

ex.en: It is lawful to ride your bike on this path.
ex.ko: 이 길에서 자전거를 타는 것은 합법이다.

easy: In a way that is relaxed and not tight.

ex.en: She tied the ribbon loosely around the box.
ex.ko: 그녀는 상자에 리본을 느슨하게 묶었다.

easy: A plant that grows in water and has big pink or white flowers.

ex.en: A pink lotus floated on the quiet pond.
ex.ko: 분홍색 연꽃이 조용한 연못 위에 떠 있었다.

easy: A person, animal, or thing that stands for a team and brings it luck.

ex.en: Our school mascot is a tiger.
ex.ko: 우리 학교 마스코트는 호랑이다.

easy: Having to do with how the body turns food into energy.

ex.en: Running makes your metabolic rate go up.
ex.ko: 달리기를 하면 신진대사 속도가 빨라진다.

easy: The middle part of a sports field, like in soccer.

ex.en: The soccer ball rolled across the midfield.
ex.ko: 축구공이 미드필드를 가로질러 굴러갔다.

easy: A warm, sad feeling when you miss the good times in the past.

ex.en: Grandpa felt nostalgia when he saw his old school.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 옛 학교를 보고 향수를 느꼈다.

easy: A flooded field where rice grows.

ex.en: Frogs jumped around in the rice paddy.
ex.ko: 개구리들이 논에서 이리저리 뛰었다.

easy: A book with a soft paper cover.

ex.en: I put a paperback in my backpack for the bus ride.
ex.ko: 나는 버스에서 읽으려고 페이퍼백 책을 가방에 넣었다.

easy: Covered with a hard, flat surface like asphalt or stone.

ex.en: We rode our bikes on the paved road.
ex.ko: 우리는 포장된 길에서 자전거를 탔다.

easy: A thin needle or arrow that shows a number on a clock or machine.

ex.en: The pointer on the scale stopped at five.
ex.ko: 저울 바늘이 5에서 멈췄다.

easy: To think something is true without checking.

ex.en: I assume it will rain because the sky is dark.
ex.ko: 하늘이 어두워서 비가 올 것 같다고 나는 생각한다.

easy: Shaped like a box side, with four straight sides and four square corners.

ex.en: My desk has a rectangular top.
ex.ko: 내 책상 윗면은 직사각형이다.

easy: A tool that controls how much water, air, or heat goes through.

ex.en: Dad turned the regulator to make the water cooler.
ex.ko: 아빠는 조절기를 돌려 물을 더 시원하게 했다.

easy: Paying money to use something that is not yours for a while.

ex.en: The renting of a bike costs ten dollars a day.
ex.ko: 자전거 대여료는 하루에 10달러다.

easy: Breaking or ruining something on purpose to stop it from working.

ex.en: The villain's sabotage stopped the machine.
ex.ko: 악당의 파괴 행위로 기계가 멈췄다.

easy: A big, flat grassland in a hot place, with few trees.

ex.en: Lions and zebras live on the savannah.
ex.ko: 사자와 얼룩말은 사바나에 산다.

easy: Cutting hair off the skin with a razor.

ex.en: Dad's shaving takes only five minutes.
ex.ko: 아빠의 면도는 5분밖에 안 걸린다.

easy: A very thin piece cut off from something, like wood.

ex.en: Wood shavings piled up under the workbench.
ex.ko: 작업대 밑에 대팻밥이 쌓였다.

easy: The stopping of work or when a place closes.

ex.en: The shutdown of the old factory made many people sad.
ex.ko: 오래된 공장의 폐쇄로 많은 사람이 슬퍼했다.

easy: Doing very well, growing, and full of life.

ex.en: The flowers in our garden are thriving.
ex.ko: 우리 정원의 꽃들은 잘 자라고 있다.

easy: With everyone agreeing and nobody saying no.

ex.en: The class unanimously chose pizza for the party.
ex.ko: 반 친구들은 파티 음식으로 만장일치로 피자를 골랐다.

easy: Never having lost a game or a fight.

ex.en: Our team stayed undefeated all season.
ex.ko: 우리 팀은 시즌 내내 무패였다.

easy: Not known to you; new or strange.

ex.en: The new school felt unfamiliar on the first day.
ex.ko: 새 학교는 첫날에 낯설게 느껴졌다.

easy: Low land between hills, often with a river.

ex.en: A small river runs through the green valley.
ex.ko: 작은 강이 푸른 골짜기를 따라 흐른다.

easy: By a very large amount.

ex.en: The new library is vastly bigger than the old one.
ex.ko: 새 도서관은 옛 도서관보다 엄청나게 크다.

easy: So bad that it makes you feel sick.

ex.en: The vile smell came from the old trash can.
ex.ko: 그 역겨운 냄새는 오래된 쓰레기통에서 났다.

easy: In a rough, wild, and very strong way.

ex.en: The waves crashed violently against the rocks.
ex.ko: 파도가 바위에 격렬하게 부딪혔다.

easy: In a smart way, using good thinking.

ex.en: She wisely saved her money for a new bike.
ex.ko: 그녀는 새 자전거를 사려고 돈을 현명하게 모았다.

easy: Broken and ruined, often in a crash.

ex.en: The wrecked car sat by the side of the road.
ex.ko: 부서진 자동차가 길가에 서 있었다.

easy: Able to change to fit new places or new things.

ex.en: The chameleon has adaptive skin that changes color.
ex.ko: 카멜레온은 색이 변하는 적응력 있는 피부를 가졌다.

easy: Hard to stop because your body or mind wants it again and again.

ex.en: Some video games can be addictive.
ex.ko: 어떤 비디오 게임은 중독성이 있을 수 있다.

easy: A sickness that makes your joints hurt and swell.

ex.en: Grandma has arthritis in her knees.
ex.ko: 할머니는 무릎에 관절염이 있다.

easy: A person who comes to visit your home.

ex.en: We had a caller at the door this morning.
ex.ko: 오늘 아침 현관에 방문객이 왔다.

easy: A soldier who is hurt, killed, or missing in a war.

ex.en: Many casualties were reported after the battle.
ex.ko: 전투 후에 많은 사상자가 보고되었다.

easy: A person who is hurt or killed in an accident.

ex.en: Help came quickly for the casualties of the crash.
ex.ko: 사고 부상자들에게 도움이 빨리 왔다.

easy: An empty space inside something.

ex.en: Birds made a nest in the tree cavity.
ex.ko: 새들이 나무 구멍에 둥지를 지었다.

easy: Making you feel calm and less sad.

ex.en: Mom's hug was very comforting.
ex.ko: 엄마의 포옹은 큰 위로가 되었다.

easy: A building where judges and courts work.

ex.en: We saw the old courthouse on our trip.
ex.ko: 우리는 여행에서 오래된 법원 건물을 보았다.

easy: To make someone feel that something is very yucky.

ex.en: The rotten egg smell disgusted everyone.
ex.ko: 썩은 달걀 냄새가 모두를 역겹게 했다.

easy: Breaking apart into small pieces.

ex.en: The dissolution of the old barn took many years.
ex.ko: 낡은 헛간이 허물어지는 데 여러 해가 걸렸다.

easy: The way something mixes into liquid and seems to disappear.

ex.en: The dissolution of sugar in tea is quick.
ex.ko: 차 속에서 설탕이 녹는 것은 빠르다.

easy: Making something two times as big or as many.

ex.en: The doubling of the recipe fed the whole class.
ex.ko: 요리법을 두 배로 늘리니 반 전체가 먹을 수 있었다.

easy: A place with a fence or walls around it.

ex.en: The horses stayed in their enclosure.
ex.ko: 말들은 울타리 안에 머물러 있었다.

easy: Very beautiful and made with great care.

ex.en: She wore an exquisite dress to the wedding.
ex.ko: 그녀는 결혼식에 아름다운 드레스를 입었다.

easy: Based on facts that are true.

ex.en: This book has factual stories about sharks.
ex.ko: 이 책에는 상어에 관한 사실적인 이야기가 있다.

easy: Slowly getting weaker or quieter.

ex.en: The fading of the sunset turned the sky dark.
ex.ko: 노을이 사라지자 하늘이 어두워졌다.

easy: In a wrong way that is not true.

ex.en: He was falsely blamed for the broken window.
ex.ko: 그는 깨진 창문에 대해 억울하게 비난받았다.

easy: Tricky and not honest, made to fool people.

ex.en: The fraudulent seller took money and never sent the toy.
ex.ko: 그 사기꾼 판매자는 돈만 받고 장난감을 보내지 않았다.

easy: An old woman; a grandmother.

ex.en: Granny baked cookies for us.
ex.ko: 할머니는 우리에게 쿠키를 구워 주셨다.

easy: A small help given to a weaker player so the game is fair.

ex.en: The younger player got a handicap in the race.
ex.ko: 어린 선수는 달리기에서 유리한 조건을 받았다.

easy: A very unfriendly feeling toward someone.

ex.en: There was hostility between the two teams.
ex.ko: 두 팀 사이에는 적대감이 있었다.

easy: Based on a guess, not on proof.

ex.en: It is just a hypothetical question about aliens.
ex.ko: 그것은 외계인에 관한 가정일 뿐인 질문이다.

easy: Giving you new things to learn.

ex.en: The museum show was very informative.
ex.ko: 박물관 전시는 아주 유익했다.

easy: To enter another country with an army to take it.

ex.en: The army invaded the small country.
ex.ko: 군대가 그 작은 나라를 침략했다.

easy: To come into a place or space where you are not wanted.

ex.en: Don't invade my room without knocking.
ex.ko: 노크 없이 내 방에 함부로 들어오지 마.

easy: A plant with sweet-smelling white flowers.

ex.en: The jasmine by our window smells so sweet.
ex.ko: 우리 창가의 재스민은 향기가 아주 좋다.

easy: Cloth made from the flax plant, used for light clothes.

ex.en: Dad wore a linen shirt on the hot day.
ex.ko: 아빠는 더운 날 린넨 셔츠를 입으셨다.

easy: A high place where you can look far away.

ex.en: The guard climbed to the lookout to watch for fire.
ex.ko: 경비원은 불을 살피려고 망루에 올랐다.

easy: Not understood the right way.

ex.en: The misunderstood dog was really very friendly.
ex.ko: 오해받던 그 개는 사실 아주 다정했다.

easy: The light that comes from the Moon.

ex.en: Moonlight made the lake shine silver.
ex.ko: 달빛이 호수를 은빛으로 빛나게 했다.

easy: A very big deer with wide, flat antlers that lives in cold places.

ex.en: We saw a moose eating plants by the lake.
ex.ko: 우리는 호숫가에서 풀을 먹는 무스를 보았다.

easy: A hotel where people stay while traveling by car.

ex.en: We slept at a motel on our road trip.
ex.ko: 우리는 자동차 여행 중 모텔에서 잤다.

easy: A person who writes long made-up stories in books.

ex.en: My aunt is a novelist and writes stories.
ex.ko: 우리 이모는 소설가이고 이야기를 쓴다.

easy: Taking power away from a leader, often by force.

ex.en: The people cheered the overthrow of the cruel king.
ex.ko: 사람들은 잔인한 왕이 쫓겨나자 환호했다.

easy: A perfect, typical example of something.

ex.en: Our teacher is a paradigm of kindness.
ex.ko: 우리 선생님은 친절의 본보기다.

easy: The hard surface of a road.

ex.en: The ball rolled across the pavement.
ex.ko: 공이 포장도로 위를 굴러갔다.

easy: The day when you get paid for your work.

ex.en: Mom bought us ice cream on payday.
ex.ko: 엄마는 월급날 우리에게 아이스크림을 사 주셨다.

easy: The study of how living bodies work.

ex.en: In physiology class we learned how the heart pumps blood.
ex.ko: 생리학 시간에 우리는 심장이 피를 보내는 방법을 배웠다.

easy: A gray bird that lives in cities and coos.

ex.en: A pigeon sat on the park bench.
ex.ko: 비둘기 한 마리가 공원 벤치에 앉아 있었다.

easy: A list of songs to play one after another.

ex.en: I made a playlist for the car ride.
ex.ko: 나는 차 타고 갈 때 들을 재생 목록을 만들었다.

easy: A fast growth in how many there are of something.

ex.en: There was a proliferation of cell phones in our town.
ex.ko: 우리 동네에서 휴대전화가 빠르게 늘어났다.

easy: Fake; not real but trying to look real.

ex.en: He told a pseudo story to trick his friends.
ex.ko: 그는 친구들을 속이려고 가짜 이야기를 지어냈다.

easy: A big box in the kitchen that keeps food cold.

ex.en: Put the milk back in the refrigerator.
ex.ko: 우유를 다시 냉장고에 넣어라.

easy: Growing back a part of the body that was lost.

ex.en: A lizard can do regeneration and grow a new tail.
ex.ko: 도마뱀은 재생으로 새 꼬리가 자랄 수 있다.

easy: The power to bring back things from the past in your mind.

ex.en: I have a clear remembrance of my first day of school.
ex.ko: 나는 학교 첫날이 또렷이 기억난다.

easy: Making you think of something else from the past.

ex.en: The smell of cookies is reminiscent of Grandma's kitchen.
ex.ko: 쿠키 냄새는 할머니의 부엌을 떠올리게 한다.

easy: A long-lasting angry feeling because you were treated unfairly.

ex.en: He felt resentment when his brother got more candy.
ex.ko: 그는 형이 사탕을 더 받자 분한 마음이 들었다.

easy: A sticky stuff that comes out of trees and gets hard.

ex.en: Sticky resin dripped from the pine tree.
ex.ko: 끈적한 송진이 소나무에서 뚝뚝 떨어졌다.

easy: Turning around and around like a wheel.

ex.en: Grandpa still has a rotary phone.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 아직도 회전식 전화기를 갖고 계신다.

easy: Covered with rust, the red-brown stuff on old metal.

ex.en: The old bike was rusty and squeaked.
ex.ko: 낡은 자전거는 녹이 슬어 삐걱거렸다.

easy: Having a red-brown color like rust.

ex.en: The fox had rusty fur.
ex.ko: 그 여우는 적갈색 털을 가졌다.

easy: Your brother or sister.

ex.en: My sibling and I share a bedroom.
ex.ko: 나와 내 형제는 같은 방을 쓴다.

easy: A machine that copies real life so people can practice.

ex.en: Pilots practice flying in a simulator.
ex.ko: 조종사들은 시뮬레이터에서 비행을 연습한다.

easy: So smooth or wet that you can easily slide.

ex.en: The icy sidewalk was slippery.
ex.ko: 얼음 낀 인도가 미끄러웠다.

easy: To put something in water and leave it there.

ex.en: Soak the dirty socks in water first.
ex.ko: 더러운 양말을 먼저 물에 담가 둬라.

easy: A soft cloth cover that you wear on your foot inside your shoe.

ex.en: I can't find my other sock.
ex.ko: 나는 다른 쪽 양말을 못 찾겠다.

easy: Putting things into groups that are alike.

ex.en: Sorting the toys by color was fun.
ex.ko: 장난감을 색깔별로 분류하는 것은 재미있었다.

easy: A big, exciting show that is amazing to see.

ex.en: The fireworks were a great spectacle.
ex.ko: 불꽃놀이는 대단한 장관이었다.

easy: A big, strong car that can drive on rough roads.

ex.en: Our family drove the SUV to the mountains.
ex.ko: 우리 가족은 SUV를 타고 산으로 갔다.

easy: A meeting where experts talk about one topic.

ex.en: Dad went to a symposium about space.
ex.ko: 아빠는 우주에 관한 심포지엄에 가셨다.

easy: Very exciting and makes your heart beat fast.

ex.en: The roller coaster ride was thrilling.
ex.ko: 롤러코스터는 정말 짜릿했다.

easy: The path that something takes as it flies through the air.

ex.en: The ball's trajectory curved over the fence.
ex.ko: 공의 궤적이 울타리 위로 휘어 날아갔다.

easy: Not yet known; nobody knows what it is.

ex.en: We saw an unidentified bird in the tree.
ex.ko: 우리는 나무에서 정체를 알 수 없는 새를 보았다.

easy: A feeling of being worried and upset, or trouble among people.

ex.en: There was unrest in the crowd before the game.
ex.ko: 경기 전에 관중들 사이에 불안한 분위기가 있었다.

easy: Not able to be seen.

ex.en: The unseen wind shook the leaves.
ex.ko: 보이지 않는 바람이 나뭇잎을 흔들었다.

easy: Saying that someone did something wrong.

ex.en: The teacher heard the accusation and asked questions.
ex.ko: 선생님은 그 비난을 듣고 질문을 하셨다.

easy: A small tool that lets a plug fit into a different outlet.

ex.en: I need an adapter for my charger on the trip.
ex.ko: 여행에 쓸 충전기용 어댑터가 필요하다.

easy: Can be changed to fit you.

ex.en: My backpack has adjustable straps.
ex.ko: 내 가방은 끈을 조절할 수 있다.

easy: The time of life when you are a grown-up.

ex.en: Adulthood comes with many new jobs to do.
ex.ko: 어른이 되면 해야 할 일이 많아진다.
